matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.

passages.quote:
This notice should be read in conjunction with MGN 636 (M) amendment 1 which provides details and guidance on interpretation of the merchant shipping and fishing vessel (health and safety at work) regulations 1997, MGN 587 (F) amendment 1 (in respect of fishing vessels) and the merchant shipping and fishing vessels (control of noise at work) regulations 1997, MGN 447 (M+F) amendment 1 merchant shipping and fishing vessel (control of noise at work) regulations 1997 procedure for seeking exemptions.

This notice replaces MGN 352 (M+F) amendment 1 the merchant shipping and fishing vessels (control of noise at work) regulations 2007 and MGN 377 (M+F) sound advice – noise at work from music and entertainment.

Notice to

ship and fishing vessel owners

ship operators

charterers

managers

skippers and other employers of seafarers

masters

chief engineers

officers

ratings and other workers on merchant ships

crew of fishing vessels

small commercially operated vessels

yachts with paid crew and self-employed persons working on board

classification societies

certifying authorities

test houses

competent persons
